title: US-Taiwan AI Semiconductor Macro & Cross-Asset Context
scope: Reusable macro state for AI semiconductor bottleneck suppliers, with TSM-specific transmission kept in the linked Investment Case.

factor_channels.transmission: higher real yields -> higher required equity return -> lower acceptable P/E for long-duration growth; does not by itself invalidate foundry earnings
factor_channels.green: 10Y real yield sustainably <=2.0% with inflation/growth not collapsing
factor_channels.red_reunderwrite: sustained >=2.75%, especially if earnings revisions flatten or risk premia widen

factor_channels.transmission: sticky inflation delays easing and lifts discount rates; severe reacceleration can also weaken risk appetite and customer financing economics
factor_channels.red_reunderwrite: renewed inflation acceleration that materially lifts expected policy rates/real yields

factor_channels.transmission: slower broad growth pressures consumer/industrial semis but AI/HPC can remain decoupled; recession matters if cloud monetization and enterprise AI demand also weaken
factor_channels.red_reunderwrite: broad slowdown plus cloud/AI demand deterioration and TSM monthly/guidance weakness

factor_channels.transmission: real compute capex -> accelerator/custom ASIC demand -> TSM leading-edge and advanced-packaging workload -> utilization/margins -> EPS/FCF
factor_channels.green: at least two major hyperscalers maintain/raise real compute plans and AI/cloud demand remains strong
factor_channels.yellow: headline capex stays high but incremental spend shifts toward buildings, leases or component inflation
factor_channels.red_reunderwrite: at least two major hyperscalers cut real compute plans plus cloud/AI demand and TSM/accelerator evidence deteriorate

factor_channels.transmission: industry demand and node transitions affect utilization, pricing, margin and capex productivity
factor_channels.red_reunderwrite: persistent advanced-node/packaging utilization deterioration or broad inventory correction reaching AI/HPC

factor_channels.transmission: TSMC reports in TWD with much revenue economically linked to USD; FX influences translated margins/earnings and ADR/local-share parity
factor_channels.monitoring_rule: track trend and abrupt moves; never treat FX alone as a trade signal

factor_channels.transmission: rules can change customer addressable markets, accelerator shipments, equipment access and location/cost of capacity; subsidies and localization can partially offset but raise overseas-fab cost
factor_channels.red_reunderwrite: new controls materially impair a major TSM customer/product class or production capability

factor_channels.transmission: risk premium can widen long before cash flows change; actual disruption could impair production, logistics, power, personnel, shipping or market access
factor_channels.monitoring_rule: distinguish rhetoric/exercises from verified operating impairment; operational disruption is immediate kill/reunderwrite trigger

factor_channels.transmission: fabs are power intensive; persistent energy shocks or Taiwan power constraints can affect costs/resilience, while AI infrastructure power bottlenecks can also pace end-demand deployment
factor_channels.red_reunderwrite: verified sustained production impact or hyperscaler deployment delay caused by power bottlenecks

linked_cases.dominant_macro_chain: hyperscaler_real_compute_capex -> advanced_node_and_packaging_demand -> utilization_margin_fcf -> eps_revisions, overlaid by real_yields and Taiwan risk premium

next_evidence_nodes: next FOMC decision and Summary of Economic Projections
any material US export-control or Taiwan-operational-risk event
decision_rule: Macro changes the hurdle rate, expected return, position risk budget and in some cases operating thesis. Never translate a single macro threshold into an automatic buy/sell instruction.
